page.overview:
Who is Rocco Ignacio?

Father Rocco Ignacio is a fictional character created by American author Armand Rosamilia for his Keyport Cthulhu series of Mythos stories.

A man in his twilight years, Father Rocco has ministered to the steadily dwindling parish of the Keyport Church of God for decades. Despite the Esoteric Order of Dagon's attempts to run him out of town and his flock's loss of faith, he himself remains a devout servant of his Lord.

In the first book of the series, fugitive criminal Bones arrived in Keyport and he and Father Rocco joined forces to combat the sinister Esoteric Order of Dagon's scheme to awaken Cthulhu, recruiting the help of others along the way. Although badly beaten by cultists at the story's conclusion, Father Rocco clung to life as a terrifying monstrosity rose from the depths of Keyport Bay.

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Humans
